info.name: Justice Desk API
info.description: Justice Desk API (mounted routes only). Set baseUrl and resource IDs in collection variables. Protected endpoints use the accessToken bearer token; login and email verification also set httpOnly accessToken/refreshToken cookies. Refresh Token and Logout use the Postman cookie jar. Schedules use a single startDateTime/endDateTime range with totalSlots capacity. Most API responses use the success/message/data envelope, with paginated endpoints also returning meta. Login and registration flows may require real email OTPs or provider credentials.

item.name: GET Root
item.description: Public welcome endpoint.

item.name: GET bKash Test Token
item.description: Public diagnostic endpoint that requests a bKash grant token using server configuration, then returns the welcome message. Requires valid bKash credentials.

item.name: Refresh Token
item.description: Uses the refreshToken httpOnly cookie set by Login or Verify Client Email; keep the Postman cookie jar enabled.

item.name: Logout
item.description: Clears the accessToken and refreshToken cookies in the Postman cookie jar.

item.name: Specializations
item.description: Public endpoints list specialization data. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN manage specializations and review requests. LAWYER submits specializationId or newPracticeArea (exactly one), and only approved requests become active specializations.

item.name: Lawyer Request New Practice Area
item.description: LAWYER only. Submit a new practice area for admin review instead of sending specializationId. Provide exactly one of specializationId or newPracticeArea.

item.name: Get Specialization
item.description: Public endpoint. Returns one specialization by ID.

item.name: Get Lawyer Specializations
item.description: Public endpoint. Lists approved specializations for the lawyer ID.

item.name: Admin Delete Specialization
item.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only.

item.name: Admin Reject Specialization Request
item.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. rejectionReason is required when status is REJECTED.

item.name: Appointments and Payments
item.description: Mounted under /api/v1/appointment. CLIENTs book and pay; CLIENT/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN can cancel; LAWYERs update appointment status; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN list all appointments. A booking is confirmed and assigned its serial number after successful payment. Stripe webhooks require a valid signature; bKash callbacks are provider redirects.

item.name: Stripe Webhook - manual signature testing
item.description: Stripe-only raw-body webhook. A valid stripe-signature generated for this exact request body is required; use Stripe CLI forwarding for realistic testing. The placeholder signature will fail.

item.name: Stripe Payment Success Callback
item.description: Stripe redirects here with session_id after checkout. On success, returns a confirmation page and redirects to the frontend appointments page.

item.name: Stripe Payment Cancel Callback
item.description: Public callback used when checkout is cancelled; returns a JSON cancellation message.

item.name: Client Join Appointment
item.description: Client-only route. The current time must be between the schedule startDateTime and endDateTime. Sets joiningTime and changes CONFIRMED to ONGOING; an already ONGOING appointment keeps its status.

item.name: Schedules
item.description: LAWYERs create one future schedule per UTC calendar day, using a single startDateTime/endDateTime range on the same day, a positive totalSlots value, and a valid meetingLink. Only draft schedules can be edited. Authenticated users can list available schedules; GET /today is public.

item.name: Today's Schedules
item.description: Public endpoint; no bearer token is required.

item.name: Payment Queries
item.description: Clients can list their own payments and admins can list all payments. Payment details are available to the owning client and admins.

item.name: Lawyer Module
item.description: Apply as a lawyer using multipart/form-data fields user and lawyer (each a JSON string), plus optional resume and up to five additionalFiles. The lawyer object must include at least one specializationId or newPracticeArea. Admin review, profile/document management, and public lawyer lookup are included below.

item.name: Apply as Lawyer - multipart
item.description: Public application endpoint. user and lawyer must be valid JSON strings in form fields. Supply specializationIds or newPracticeArea inside lawyer; selected specializations require admin approval. resume is optional; up to five additionalFiles are accepted.

body.raw:
{
  "bio": "Civil litigation and family law specialist",
  "consultationFee": 1500,
  "qualifications": "LLB, Bar Council",
  "experienceYears": 6,
  "specializationIds": ["{{specializationId}}", "{{secondSpecializationId}}"]
}

item.name: Admin Update Lawyer Profile
item.description: LAWYER may update their own profile; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN may update the lawyer identified in the URL.

item.name: Admin Update Lawyer Status
item.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. status must be ACTIVE or BLOCKED.

item.name: Admin Suspend Lawyer
item.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. Set suspended to false to lift a suspension.

item.name: Admin Delete Lawyer
item.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. This is a destructive operation.

item.name: Get Lawyer Documents
item.description: LAWYER, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN. A lawyer can access their own documents.

item.name: Update Lawyer Documents - multipart
item.description: LAWYER, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN. Send optional resume and additionalFiles fields as multipart/form-data; maximum five additionalFiles.

item.name: Delete Lawyer Document
item.description: LAWYER, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN. documentType must be resume or additionalFile; publicId is optional when deleting an additional file.

item.name: Cases - Core Workflow
item.description: Mounted at /api/v1/case. Recommended flow: Client creates a case from a completed appointment, then use caseId from the response for the remaining requests. Lawyer, admin, and client permissions vary by endpoint.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Property consultation",
  "description": "Need legal advice about a property dispute.",
  "caseType": "PROPERTY",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "courtName": "Dhaka District Court",
  "courtCaseNumber": "DHC-2026-001",
  "filingDate": "2025-01-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "lawyerId": "{{lawyerId}}",
  "appointmentId": "{{appointmentId}}"
}

item.name: Case Collaboration - combined workflow
item.description: Combined case workflow requests for activities, messages, reports, invoices, lawyer notes, and legal documents. Matching resource-specific folders below provide a shorter navigation view for common operations.

item.name: Legal Documents
item.description: Create and manage documents for {{caseId}}. caseId is in the URL, not the request body.

item.name: Case Activities
item.description: Lawyers and admins create activity records; clients can view them.

item.name: Case Reports
item.description: Lawyers create reports; clients and admins can view reports.

item.name: Case Invoices
item.description: Lawyers create invoices for a case; clients can list and view them.

item.name: Lawyer Notes
item.description: Internal case notes created and managed by lawyers or admins.
